reviews.author: Maria Hernandez
reviews.text: Working with this small business has been a great experience. The communication was efficient and very well organized. The business owner, Bartolomé, is quick to respond and show up to give a quote. Him and his crew arrived and completed the job efficiently. Would definitely recommend for those looking at a fairly priced, efficient, and reliable service!

reviews.author: Mich V
reviews.text: I am outright disappointed in this tree service because the owner agreed with my terms to prune my (3)trees and trim (2) bushes and didn’t follow through. He committed to the job, wasted my time and made numerous excuses to why he was a “No show”. I decided to give him another try and he failed again. I had put others on hold because he stated he would follow through and didn’t. I would not recommend this business to no one. The owner is dishonest, given false promises to committing to do the job agreed upon which is bad business. If you don’t want your time wasted and be disappointed, do not hire this business. I do not recommend Bartolome's Tree Service. I highly disapprove this business 100%. If I could give 0 stars, I would. He received a 1 star rating and to be honest Bartolome's Tree Service didn’t even deserve that!

reviews.author: Christy Silvernail
reviews.text: We have used Bartolome's Tree Service several times. He is fairly priced, always on time, and he leaves the area looking better than he found it. He is kind and goes above and beyond, I very highly recommend him!

reviews.author: Joel E Sosa
reviews.text: What an amazing local company! The owner is fantastic, knowledgeable and reasonable. I called him in the morning, and he came by to give me a quote. I was lucky that he had an opening that same afternoon to start cutting down the dead tree. His pricing was competitive, and after getting a couple of quotes from other companies, I found that Bartolo’s was the best option for our situation. He is very professional and has extensive knowledge in tree cutting. They also cleaned up after they finished their work. I am truly impressed and will definitely recommend this company to others for their tree services.

reviews.author: Angela Greene
reviews.text: Bartolome was prompt, very knowledgeable, friendly, and did excellent work for an excellent price. I highly recommend him and his team for any tree removal or pruning work.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Lucas
reviews.text: We called Bartolome on Friday and he arrived within the hour to give us a quote. Saturday, he and his crew arrived promptly at 7:00 a.m. to remove 7 trees. He and his crew worked quickly and efficiently removing the trees, cleaning up all the branches and restoring the yard to it's original condition. They were very courteous, reasonably priced and finished the job by early afternoon. I would highly recommend their service.

reviews.author: Trish Aussem
reviews.text: Oh my gosh, if you need any tree work done you need to call Bartolomes Tree Service. You won’t be sorry! He was here on Friday for a quote and two days later he was here at 7:00 am to do the job. He was way less than the other quote I got for even more work. I have never seen such hard workers. They only stopped for a 15 minute lunch break. My yard was cleaned up perfectly when they were done. Definitely give Bartolome’s Tree Service your business.

reviews.author: Josh Bumgardner
reviews.text: He showed up on a Sunday and quoted me and was out Monday morning taking care if the removing the trees. Stand up guy was done with 3 Bradford pears before lunch.

reviews.author: Heather Arrington
reviews.text: Great service! While competing companies didn’t even pick up the phone, Bartolome’s responded and showed up personally within an hour to give a fair-priced estimate and even offered to remove the tree on the spot (we elected to have it removed the next morning). Friendly, punctual and professional! I would highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Hannah Rivard
reviews.text: Very happy with his service. Fast response. Other well known tree services in the area would give a quote, and then disappear. He was very good at communication, on time, and the finished job was better than I expected. He raked the extra debris, and leaf blew it clean. Careful of our septic lines. So happy with his service. Would recommend and use again. If you haven't used him before, you won't be disappointed!

reviews.author: Calin Davidson
reviews.text: These guys are awesome! I had a huge elm that was leaning towards my house, so naturally had some concerns about how this could be removed without dropping limbs on my brand new roof. Barolome's gave me a quote the same day I called, and did the job 2 business days after I hired him. Absolute champ, so rare these days. Service was quick and pain free, nothing fell on the house. They also did a great job cleaning up afterwards as well, definitely suggest adding on the stump removal and cleanup services.

reviews.author: Leslie V
reviews.text: I used Bartolome Tree Service in March 2021 to prune my Crepe Myrtle trees and to trim my hedges beside my porch. I highly recommend this business to All because it was a hidden Gem that I wished I had known about. This gentleman has his own equipment and the limbs, branches and debris are grinded into mulch in the machine. He is very neat and Super professional from start to finish. This was not a rush job. It's clear that they know what they are doing and it didn't take long to finish because they had all of the equipment to do the job. My yard was clean prior to starting but when they were done; they thoroughly cleaned the yard so much better. I was over the moon with their work. They don't string you along. They will come to your location and give you a reasonable price that can't be beat. I will continue to utilize this business for future projects. Bartolome, your business is the Best! Thanks for your honesty, integrity, professionalism, and your amazing Work!

reviews.author: Nathan Reynolds
reviews.text: Same day quote, insured, quick responses, reasonable priced. Had a tree down and cleaned up in an hour. This tree had termite damage and was close to our neighbors property, they handled it professionally.

reviews.author: Megan Bixler
reviews.text: Dealings with this company were great! They showed up - on time - to conduct an estimate. Then, they showed up early on the agreed upon morning to cut my tree down. They cleaned up the mess the tree left and were incredibly positive the entire time.

reviews.author: Pamela Cameron
reviews.text: Wonderful, professional job. They had the job done within 3 hours. Coming back to do more work for me. Can’t recommend enough!!!

reviews.author: Hannibal Hills
reviews.text: Removed three trees from our property. Very professional, tidy, and friendly. Also, great value. Five stars well earned, and we will be using them again. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jonathan Davis
reviews.text: Arrived on time and were completely finished in less than two hours. Large pine taken down. Cleaned up yard. Stump ground. They even remove debris. We will definitely be using them again.

reviews.author: susan andersen
reviews.text: We had some trees removed and were very pleased with this company. On time, polite, cleaned up the area, very fair price. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Valerie Love-Koyama
reviews.text: Will always use him in the future. Reasonable prices. Shows up Quickly, get the work done quickly. Have used him multiple times now and is a very nice, respectful guy.

reviews.author: Amy Guadarrama Hernandez
reviews.text: He answered fast and we had called so many companies and they would not show up on time and would take so much time to respond to us but he did show up and gave us a great price and was very respectful and kind .

reviews.author: Jacob Elliott
reviews.text: This is the go-to crew for tree removal, stump grinding, and limbing. Very courteous and professional team! I will be working with these guys again.

reviews.author: Bryan Schleigh
reviews.text: This is hands down a service I would recommend. These guys are thorough and fast! Very fair price, good guys. Can’t go wrong!

reviews.author: Marty Reynolds
reviews.text: Did a fantastic job! Cleaned everything up and did the job in a timely manner for the price quoted! Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Berkley Griffin Hillis
reviews.text: So so great! Easy to work with, SO communicative. Job was done and everything was cleaned up faster than I could have imagined.
